signal: S-Docs shipped version 11.3.1 and a February 2026 release, deepening its Salesforce-native document generation and e-signature platform.

email.body1:
Megan, saw S-Docs shipped its latest release deepening native Salesforce document generation and e-signature.

New releases usually expand the target list faster than the sales team can cover, so more in-market accounts sit untouched and deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for S-Docs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Megan, quick follow-up for S-Docs.

In a crowded Salesforce ecosystem, the bottleneck is rarely the product, it is reaching enough of the right accounts before competitors do. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings S-Docs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Megan, last bit of proof for S-Docs.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how S-Docs's reply rate likely compares to other Salesforce-ecosystem vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Megan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Shipping releases and running sales at once is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to S-Docs either way.
